description: Call before signing a Solana swap, to decide whether and how to trade it. Returns Safe (trade normally), Protect (trade through a Jito bundle, with the tip to use) or Refuse (do not trade), with plain-language reasons, the output token's risk score, the sandwich exposure for this trade size, and the route. Builds no transaction and handles no keys. $0.01 in USDC per call, paid via x402 on Solana mainnet; the market data is mainnet. To get the transaction itself, call zendiq_optimize_swap.

amount.description: Amount to sell, in the input mint's atomic units, as a decimal string. For 1 SOL (9 decimals) send "1000000000".

inputMint.description: Base58 mint address of the token being sold.

outputMint.description: Base58 mint address of the token being bought.

slippageBps.description: Optional slippage tolerance in basis points. Omit to use the route default.

name: zendiq_triage_swap

path.description: Execution path to use, e.g. jupiter_direct or jito_bundle.

title: Triage a Solana swap
